newsitem.title: INDIA: Unilever opens India research laboratory.
newsitem.headline: Unilever opens India research laboratory.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever Plc on Wednesday inaugurated an international research laboratory in the southern city of Bangalore, its Indian subsidiary Hindustan Lever Ltd said.
The Bangalore facility has been built with an initial investment of 250 million rupees, the firm said.
It was inaugurated by Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram on Wednesday.
The Bangalore laboratory will, to begin with, focus on tea science and skin research to meet both global and regional requirements in these two core product categories of Unilever.

It is Unilever's second such facility outside Europe and North America. The first was opened in Shanghai, China, in October 1996. A third laboratory will be set up in Sao Paolo, Brazil, later this year, it said.
